proxy_evidence.protocol: four spatial quadrants x draws 20/21, models trained with the hidden components removed (H34 screen)
proxy_evidence.note: the catalogue-hidden proxy reproduces the known real ranking of all three historical files (0.2600 > 0.2477 > 0.1922); the SGMC off-catalogue proxy inverts it. Both are proxies; the artifact itself trains on the full catalogue so its own holdout score would be contaminated and is deliberately not computed

files.summary: Trained on every supplied catalogue pixel (HGB, 3-seed average) over the frozen feature matrix used by the H34 controls, then the frozen standard emission: Hessian ridge NMS -> drop known catalogue -> top 2.45% of the footprint -> score-ordered Poisson-disk dots at 2.4 px. 37,913 dots, zero catalogue pixels. The method it implements scored 0.1409 on the catalogue-hidden proxy against 0.0983/0.0945/0.0697 for the historical D2.8/d1.5/H19-5 files on the identical protocol and draws, so it is the best-evidenced candidate in this repository. It is a proxy-fired research candidate, not a competition score; the SGMC off-catalogue proxy prefers the historical file, and that conflict is registered.
